notes: Company: Retainly merchant-facing returns + shipping assistant for mid-size merchants (SaaS).
Primary buyer: Head of Product (Maya Lin) + CTO (Ethan Shaw). Procurement involved for >= $100k ARR.
Use case: conversational returns/shipper agent that does MRCP-style multi-turn flows, order lookups, and generates labels via carrier API tool calls.
Latency: repeated emphasis on p95 <= 220ms for short-turn messages (order lookup + response). Want streaming for user perceived latency on long responses.
Traffic profile: baseline 2k concurrent chats, seasonal spike (peak season) up to 18-22k concurrent for ~12 hours (Black Friday/Cyber Week).
Quote from Maya on demo call: "We need answers in under a quarter-second for simple queries or we'll fallback to bot-to-human more often."
They want automatic fallback policy: hosted -> dedicated (or cheaper model) with region-aware routing. Also must support tool calling to carrier APIs with secure creds (KMS).
Security: will require SSO/SAML, SOC2 documentation, audit log retention for 13 months, and customer-managed KMS for Dedicated/Private.
Commercial: leaning Hosted first to de-risk build; committed Dedicated only if burst pricing and latency SLA match needs. Interested in discounted reserved commit for winter season.
POC artifacts: we proposed synthetic replay harness + real order lookup integration (token-sanitized). Drive deck: drive:/decks/retainly-poc-scope-2026-02.pdf
throughput_target: peak 20k concurrent chat sessions (12 hour window), baseline 2k concurrent
peak_traffic_patterns: Daily baseline with large seasonal spike (Black Friday/Cyber Week). Peak ~10x baseline for 8-14 hours; want autoscale & burst capacity guarantees.
poc_results_summary: Week 1 hosted POC (synthetic replay) - 48h run scheduled: measure p95 for short messages and end-to-end tool-call latency
Initial synthetic run: p95 (generation only) ~180-240ms depending on sequence length; tool-call add-on increased end-to-end to ~320-420ms (network bound)
Key metric to validate: p95 including tool callouts under peak concurrency. If >220ms, evaluate Dedicated with GPU pinned config + local carrier proxy to reduce network hop.
Cost signals: hosted token costs acceptable at baseline; at 50M tokens/mo Dedicated TCO becomes attractive but requires 6-12 month commit
demo_feedback: Likes: streaming responses, deterministic function-calling examples, per-route latency analytics in Console
Concerns: real-world tool-call latency and how Redwood handles connection pooling to carrier APIs; need patterns for secure credential injection (KMS).
